Subject: CSR match + swag pickup plan for reference

Hi Jamie —

Thanks again for agreeing to be a reference for Redwood. We want to make sure we acknowledge your team's time in a way that fits your org. Two options we typically offer for reference participation:

- CSR donation match: Redwood will donate up to $1,000 to a charity you pick (we can issue one check/receipt in your name).
- Swag kit + developer credits: two swag kits for your engineering leads and a $500 service credit applied to your account.

If you prefer the CSR route, we can also add a small matching donation from GreenWave (we handle the paperwork). For logistics, quick asks:
1) Confirm preferred option (donation vs swag+credit)
2) If donation, please provide the charity name and preferred mailing address for the receipt
3) If swag, confirm shipping address and any preferred sizes (S/M/L)

I attached a short donation authorization form and a swag pickup note so you can see the timelines. If it's easier, happy to hop on a 15-minute call to finalize.

Thanks — really appreciate you helping us with the case study.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Laura —

Thanks — excited to help. Our preference is the CSR donation match. We work closely with the San Mateo Community Food Bank and would love the donation to go there.

Details:
- Charity: San Mateo Community Food Bank
- Please address the receipt to: GreenWave Media, Attn: Jamie Ortiz, 412 Harbor Ave, San Mateo, CA 94401
- We still appreciate a small swag kit for our two engineers (Alex and Priya) if that's possible — sizes: M, L.

If you can send the donation form prefilled, I'll route it internally for the final sign-off. Also need a receipt for our records once the donation is processed.

Appreciate it — happy to be on the brief reference call next week.

Jamie —

Great, thanks for confirming. Per your info above, next steps from our side:

1) I'll have finance issue the donation to San Mateo Community Food Bank and generate a receipt addressed to GreenWave Media (Attn: Jamie Ortiz).
2) We will send two swag kits via our US fulfillment partner; sizes M and L. Pickup instructions attached; we can ship to the address you provided if that works.
3) I'll arrange a $0 invoice credit entry to our billing system so nothing appears as an expense on your end — that'll be reflected as a marketing courtesy credit (invoice stub attached).

Thanks again for taking the time — we'll make this as frictionless as possible.
